analysis_plan: Use original driver defaults and unchanged scientific functions; alter only output destinations and add deterministic logging hooks.

Recount rejection rates, exact denominators and pointwise Wilson 95% intervals from newly stored per-seed decisions. Compare original-driver rounded output and historical summaries after complete prescribed runs.
Retain all nine ablation settings and all grid/stress cells; distinguish the legacy .18/.90 heuristic thresholds from alpha .05.
For adaptive beta, record both statistics, product means, standard errors, estimated exponent and squared weight norms on every draw. Do not infer universal impossibility or fixed-exponent validity.
Recorded summaries are retained; supplementary diagnostic interpretations do not establish calibrated inference.
No data-dependent exclusion, source correction, new seed, hyperparameter tuning or repeated favorable rerun. If failure occurs, preserve logs and report; no silent replacement.

adaptive_beta.adaptive_beta_estimator: Negative log-log slope of absolute adjacent product-mean differences, clipped to [0.5,2]; estimated from same evaluation spectrum.

generalization.reason_for_replay: No per-seed historical records exist; exact logging needed before retaining a quantified grid table. Comparator fidelity is audited separately, not repaired by replay.

stress.reason_for_replay: Recount all stress rates from individual decisions rather than copying CSV aggregates.

purpose: Reproduction of supplementary synthetic diagnostic comparisons; these comparisons do not establish calibrated inference.

resources.notes: At most two original suites concurrently; balanced panels at most 36000 rows, no dense n-by-n arrays in these selected grid routines. Preserve failed and completed outputs; no completed-subset claim.

scientific_scope: Synthetic _fast_resid fits both nuisance components jointly within each training fold. The synthetic panels are balanced, so unequal-cluster centering is not present in this comparison.
Row-random folds, shared empirical ranks and finite bins do not establish a calibrated conditional-rank null.
Adaptive beta uses the evaluation products and does not account for adaptation in its standard error. This is one heuristic, not an impossibility theorem.
Long-ladder failure and absence of fold-scheme ablation were already documented before September.
